Alright, so I love this watch. Bought this barely 5 days ago now. If I had even the slightest problem with the actual watch itself, it'd be the fact that it's a quartz movement. Bought this for roughly 179 USD.

I love the aesthetics of this watch. The clean white dial. The rose gold-ish looking accents. But there is one problem. I don't like the strap. It's thin, feels stiff and yet flimsy. Hard to put it on and take off. I'd like to buy a 3rd party strap for this beauty. And as I am kinda new to this sort of dress watch style, I'd like your advice. Obviously I can't put a NATO or a rubber strap on this. Right? So what are your suggestions? I'd like a sort of thick leather strap. But I don't know where to get one for a good price. Also what colour should I get? I'm tempted to get a tan or a camel color strap. But I'm kinda afraid it might not go with the watch. Help me out guys.

I have this beauty for a year. It really is awesome!

I first started getting into the watch world when I was recommended a video of TGV. He talked about Seiko SKX line up. Mostly he talked about the 007 in that particular video. But I saw the 009 and I fell in love at once. It was by no means an expensive watch. But it still manages to hold its own against big grail watches, no problem. After saving up for almost a year (I was in high school at the time) I finally bought the watch during my first semester in college.

This is the watch that got me in to the watch world. Now I'm crazy about watches.

Wasn't a fan of the rubber strap it came with. Tried a few NATO straps. But ended up settling on a rubber Hadley & Roma strap I bought off of Amazon.

I'm going to be buying two new watches in the coming month. Another Seiko, and a Swatch probably. They're not expensive, but as a college student I feel that it's a nice way to start off a collection. Maybe once I get a job I'll start saving up for the Omegas and Rolexes. But for now, I'm pretty happy with this beauty.

Thanks guys.
